product.name: Prime RNA
product.description: Prime RNA is synthesized RNA with precise lengths and consistent 3' ends, designed for research and development applications requiring high purity and functionality.

product.name: SPEcific Capture and Cleavage (SPECC) RNA
product.description: SPECC RNA is a platform for synthesizing mRNA free from contaminants like double-stranded RNA and truncated RNA, tailored for immune-silent therapeutic applications.

product.name: Custom RNA Synthesis Service
product.description: A service to produce RNA molecules based on user-provided sequences, with options for quality levels and quantities tailored to research needs.

product.name: Off-the-Shelf RNA Products
product.description: Pre-synthesized RNA molecules including aptamers, transfer RNA, messenger RNA, ribozymes, and other RNA types available for immediate order.
